working_geometry_plain: The working Phase 2 geometry is PEPS3D-anchored finite response-quotient carrier geometry. After AH_shared_member_frontier_fiber_K, the earned object is a finite table of 153 shared-member fibers over 495 memberships, 387 frontier pairs, 351 support-cell pair keys, 27 residue-delta values, and 135 covered source rows.
